EMPLOYMENT = SCAN_DOCS(CONTRACTEXHIBIT, all) -> SEM_FILTER('document is an EX-10 employment agreement with a finite stated employee non-solicitation period') -> SEM_EXTRACT('employment document ID, stated employer name, canonical employer key, employee name, normalized person key, and employee non-solicitation duration in years', {employment_document: string, company_name: string, company_key: string, employee_name: string, person_key: string, non_solicitation_duration_years: float}); CERT302 = SCAN_DOCS(CONTRACTEXHIBIT, all) -> SEM_FILTER('document is an EX-31 SOX Section 302 certification') -> SEM_EXTRACT('canonical certified-company key, officer name, normalized person key, and officer title', {company_key: string, officer_name: string, person_key: string, officer_title: string}); POLICIES = SCAN_DOCS(CONTRACTEXHIBIT, all) -> SEM_FILTER('document is an EX-19 insider trading policy') -> SEM_EXTRACT('canonical policy-company key and stated covered-person scope', {company_key: string, covered_person_scope: string}); MATCHED = JOIN(EMPLOYMENT, CERT302, on=[company_key, person_key]) -> JOIN(POLICIES, MATCHED.company_key = POLICIES.company_key) -> SEM_FILTER('the matched certifying officer falls within the insider policy covered-person scope', input_bindings={officer_title: officer_title, covered_person_scope: covered_person_scope}) -> PROJECT(company = company_name, individual = officer_name, employment_document, non_solicitation_duration_years) -> DEDUP([company, individual, employment_document, non_solicitation_duration_years])

DELAWARE_NDAS = SCAN_DOCS(CONTRACTEXHIBIT, all) -> SEM_FILTER('document has NDA status, including dual-status SEC exhibits, and expressly states Delaware as a governing-law jurisdiction') -> SEM_EXTRACT('NDA document ID, canonical key for each stated corporate party, and six boolean confidentiality exceptions: public information, prior knowledge, independent development, third-party receipt, legal compulsion, and consent', {nda_document_id: string, company_key: string, public_information_exception: boolean, prior_knowledge_exception: boolean, independent_development_exception: boolean, third_party_receipt_exception: boolean, legal_compulsion_exception: boolean, consent_exception: boolean}); CERT302 = SCAN_DOCS(CONTRACTEXHIBIT, all) -> SEM_FILTER('document is an EX-31 SOX Section 302 certification') -> SEM_EXTRACT('canonical key for each company named in the certification', {company_key: string}); JOIN(DELAWARE_NDAS, CERT302, DELAWARE_NDAS.company_key = CERT302.company_key) -> GROUP_BY([public_information_exception, prior_knowledge_exception, independent_development_exception, third_party_receipt_exception, legal_compulsion_exception, consent_exception], nda_document_count = COUNT(DISTINCT nda_document_id), distinct_matched_company_count = COUNT(DISTINCT company_key)) -> FILTER(nda_document_count >= 2)

CLAWBACK = SCAN_DOCS(CONTRACTEXHIBIT, all) -> SEM_FILTER('document is an EX-97 clawback policy whose trigger is either financial restatement only or financial restatement plus misconduct') -> SEM_EXTRACT('canonical policy-company key and normalized trigger type', {company_key: string, trigger_type: enum[restatement_only, restatement_and_misconduct]}) -> DEDUP([company_key, trigger_type]); CERT302 = SCAN_DOCS(CONTRACTEXHIBIT, all) -> SEM_FILTER('document is an EX-31 SOX Section 302 certification') -> SEM_EXTRACT('canonical key for each company named in the certification', {company_key: string}) -> DEDUP([company_key]); SUBSIDIARIES = SCAN_DOCS(CONTRACTEXHIBIT, all) -> SEM_FILTER('document is an EX-21 subsidiary list with an explicitly identified parent company and stated subsidiary count') -> SEM_EXTRACT('canonical parent-company key and subsidiary count', {company_key: string, subsidiary_count: integer}) -> GROUP_BY(company_key, largest_subsidiary_count = MAX(subsidiary_count)); CLAWBACK -> JOIN(SUBSIDIARIES, CLAWBACK.company_key = SUBSIDIARIES.company_key) -> JOIN(CERT302, CLAWBACK.company_key = CERT302.company_key) -> GROUP_BY(trigger_type, matched_company_count = COUNT(DISTINCT company_key), avg_largest_subsidiary_count = ROUND(AVG(largest_subsidiary_count), 2))

RESTRICTIVE_NDAS = SCAN_DOCS(CONTRACTEXHIBIT, all) -> SEM_FILTER('document has NDA status') -> SEM_FILTER('document states a finite non-compete duration and contains a customer or employee non-solicitation clause') -> SEM_EXTRACT('NDA document ID, canonical key for each stated corporate party, and non-compete duration normalized to years', {nda_document_id: string, company_key: string, non_compete_duration_years: float}) -> PROJECT(nda_document_id, company_key, highly_restrictive = non_compete_duration_years > 3); POLICIES = SCAN_DOCS(CONTRACTEXHIBIT, all) -> SEM_FILTER('document is an EX-19 insider trading policy') -> SEM_EXTRACT('canonical policy-company key and whether the policy includes a blackout period, pre-clearance, and a Rule 10b5-1 provision', {company_key: string, has_blackout: boolean, has_preclearance: boolean, has_10b5_1: boolean}) -> PROJECT(company_key, comprehensive_policy = has_blackout AND has_preclearance AND has_10b5_1) -> DEDUP([company_key, comprehensive_policy]); JOIN(RESTRICTIVE_NDAS, POLICIES, RESTRICTIVE_NDAS.company_key = POLICIES.company_key) -> GROUP_BY([highly_restrictive, comprehensive_policy], matched_nda_company_pair_count = COUNT(DISTINCT [nda_document_id, company_key]), distinct_company_count = COUNT(DISTINCT company_key))

SCAN_DOCS(CONTRACTEXHIBIT, all) -> SEM_FILTER('document has NDA status, including a dual-status SEC exhibit') -> SEM_EXTRACT('explicit effective date and list of expressly stated governing-law jurisdictions', {effective_date: date|null, governing_law_jurisdictions: array[string]}) -> FILTER(effective_date >= DATE('2010-01-01') AND CARDINALITY(governing_law_jurisdictions) = 1) -> SEM_EXTRACT('presence of the five named core clauses, presence of the six standard exceptions—public information, prior knowledge, independent development, third-party receipt, legal compulsion, and consent—and whether the confidentiality term is perpetual', {has_confidential_information_definition: boolean, has_nondisclosure: boolean, has_non_use: boolean, has_return_of_materials: boolean, has_survival: boolean, has_public_information_exception: boolean, has_prior_knowledge_exception: boolean, has_independent_development_exception: boolean, has_third_party_receipt_exception: boolean, has_legal_compulsion_exception: boolean, has_consent_exception: boolean, perpetual_confidentiality_term: boolean}) -> PROJECT(jurisdiction = governing_law_jurisdictions[0], all_five_core_clauses = has_confidential_information_definition AND has_nondisclosure AND has_non_use AND has_return_of_materials AND has_survival, all_six_standard_exceptions = has_public_information_exception AND has_prior_knowledge_exception AND has_independent_development_exception AND has_third_party_receipt_exception AND has_legal_compulsion_exception AND has_consent_exception, perpetual_confidentiality_term) -> GROUP_BY(jurisdiction, nda_count = COUNT(*), all_five_core_clauses_count = SUM(all_five_core_clauses), all_six_standard_exceptions_count = SUM(all_six_standard_exceptions), perpetual_term_count = SUM(perpetual_confidentiality_term)) -> ORDER_BY(nda_count DESC) -> LIMIT(3)

BASE = SCAN_DOCS(CONTRACTEXHIBIT, all) -> SEM_FILTER('document has NDA status, including a dual-status SEC exhibit') -> SEM_EXTRACT('finite confidentiality duration normalized to years, or null when missing or non-finite, and list of expressly stated governing-law jurisdictions', {duration_years: float|null, governing_law_jurisdictions: array[string]}) -> FILTER(duration_years IS NOT NULL AND CARDINALITY(governing_law_jurisdictions) = 1) -> SEM_EXTRACT('exact five-position boolean restriction profile in this order: non-compete, customer non-solicitation, employee non-solicitation, standstill, vendor non-solicitation', {restriction_profile: array[boolean]}) -> FILTER(ANY_TRUE(restriction_profile)) -> PROJECT(jurisdiction = governing_law_jurisdictions[0], restriction_profile, duration_years) AS ELIGIBLE; JURISDICTIONS = ELIGIBLE -> GROUP_BY(jurisdiction, qualifying_nda_count = COUNT(*)) -> ORDER_BY([qualifying_nda_count DESC, jurisdiction ASC]) -> LIMIT(3); PROFILES = ELIGIBLE -> GROUP_BY([jurisdiction, restriction_profile], profile_nda_count = COUNT(*), profile_avg_duration_years = ROUND(AVG(duration_years), 2)); JOIN(JURISDICTIONS, PROFILES, JURISDICTIONS.jurisdiction = PROFILES.jurisdiction) -> ORDER_BY([qualifying_nda_count DESC, jurisdiction ASC, profile_nda_count DESC, restriction_profile ASC]) -> DEDUP([jurisdiction], keep=FIRST) -> PROJECT(jurisdiction, qualifying_nda_count, most_common_restriction_profile = restriction_profile, profile_nda_count, profile_avg_duration_years)
